methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Report: Data centers dominate Virginia’s economic development incentives
signals.signal_reading: Data centers consuming 60% of Virginia's economic incentives represent infrastructure concentration without distributed capability-building—capital flows to equipment tax breaks rather than workforce development or broad AI literacy initiatives.

signals.title: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: AI Ready Roanoke signals intentional capability-building in a non-metro region, evaluating practical AI deployment rather than merely hosting infrastructure—a potential counter-narrative to the NoVA concentration pattern if execution materializes.

signals.title: ODU, CHKD want to map hotspots of childhood asthma in Hampton Roads with AI - WHRO
signals.signal_reading: ODU-CHKD partnership applying AI to childhood asthma mapping demonstrates deep technical capability in Hampton Roads' institutional anchors, but remains confined to academic-medical elite rather than distributing AI fluency across the regional workforce.

signals.title: Virginia Tech outlines philosophy for AI adoption - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech articulating an AI adoption philosophy positions the institution as a potential knowledge transfer hub for Southwest Virginia and beyond—whether this cascades into regional peer networks or stays campus-bound will determine Build vs. Pockets trajectory.

signals.title: Virginia governor orders statewide plan to address AI cyberattacks - StateScoop
signals.signal_reading: Statewide AI cybersecurity planning suggests government capacity concentration in Richmond-NoVA corridor for defensive AI applications, but without accompanying programs to distribute that expertise, reinforces rather than bridges the capability gap.
